campaign: Aagman Waitlist Spike — Google Ads Test #1
objective: Drive waitlist signups via the first Google Ads Search campaign. This ad group captures the highest-volume, cheapest intent in the account — stock screener queries (50,000+/mo at ₹0.3–1.4 CPC) — validated by Tradomate's sustained spend.
audience: Indian retail investors and traders searching for stock screeners — they want to find stocks by criteria (ROE, debt, breakouts, technicals) and are comparing screener tools. Quality-compounder investors and breakout hunters.
success_metric: Verified waitlist signups (double opt-in). Target: cheapest CPA in the account given ₹0.3–1.4 CPCs. Budget share ~35%.
